appendix_c_comparison.detail: Appendix C partial status retained. Static source trace refines the residual to source-version metadata/lineage fallback; behavior remains UNRUN.

rows.residual: Production empty-seed search→enrich already carries content-addressed bytes: the API persists the WebEvidenceBundle, resolves the selected source to `SourceSpec(kind=bytes)`, reads CAS content by ArtifactID and verifies digest/size; `_acquire_bytes` verifies again without URL re-fetch. The remaining defect is source-metadata binding. `build_source_metadata` copies content digest/type but omits the same FetchResult’s ArtifactRef/artifact_id, byte_size, final_url, redirect_chain, ETag, Last-Modified, license, fetch_profile, lineage_parent_artifact_id and refresh_reason. SourceMetadata derives only an ArtifactID from the digest; the other fields stay at defaults. `_source_spec_from_snapshot` fills missing artifact_id, final_url, redirect_chain, ETag, Last-Modified, fetch_profile, refresh lineage, byte_size and license from `cache.get(source_url)`, which is the URL’s current record rather than the retained source snapshot. A retained v1 can therefore keep v1 bytes while inheriting same-URL v2 metadata; if v2 byte_size differs, the API rejects the valid v1 bytes. The handoff also reduces full ArtifactRef to ArtifactID, losing kind/media_type/manifest_profile_sha256. The live fetcher leaves effective fetch_profile at its default `{}`; DocSourceSpec/DocMeta do not persist fetch profile or refresh lineage, and WebEvidenceBundle retains only fields its producer supplied. Residual: bind ArtifactRef, digest, final URL/redirects/headers/license/size/effective fetch profile/refresh lineage to the same FetchResult through the persisted consumer. Prove v1 no-egress replay, same-URL v2 isolation and lineage, current-cache mutation does not contaminate/refuse v1, plus typed missing/access failure. Keep partial; behavioral and four-base evidence remain UNRUN.
